page.notes: Greek words are copied as far as they could be read; those marked [?] are doubtful, especially the accents and the Greek of the Pag. 6 annotation. The italic verse line "Proh di immortales..." and the italic opening of "Alium feci..." are uncertain in places: "feci sti" is doubtful. "concastigaret" is doubtful and may stand for castigaret. Long s is set as s throughout. The running head is printed with a full stop after CHAR.
